purpose.domain_detail: Compuware XPEDITER/TSO training/demo — processes employee wage data (hourly, sales, management) and produces an Employee Compensation Report and a Regional Sales Report
purpose.summary: CWXTCOB is the standard Compuware XPEDITER/TSO COBOL demo program used in training sessions. It reads an employee file containing hourly, sales, and management records, calculates compensation (wages, overtime, commissions), stores results in a hold table, and prints two reports: an Employee Compensation Report and a Regional Sales Report. It also demonstrates common abend scenarios (S0C7, table overflow) controlled via a PARM field.

notable_features: COMP-3 packed-decimal fields for accumulators and totals
Two-dimensional OCCURS table (HOLD-TABLE) with SET/indexed access
LINKAGE SECTION PARM processing with length field PIC S9(4) COMP
CALL to external subprograms CWXTSUBC (commission calc) and CWXTDATE (date/service calc)
COPY statements for EMPFILE, RPTEMP, RPTREGN copybooks
REDEFINES for date fields and region name table
Intentional error scenarios (S0C7, table overflow) for debugger training
